interpretation: Single-repeat feasibility pilot. Equal externally enforced time and per-call output limits; assistant-turn and reported-component thresholds are cumulative polling-based cutoffs subject to overshoot across root/children/maintenance/phases, not hard provider-request or invoice caps. ALG internal gates are diagnostics, never the independent oracle. Reported cost is telemetry only. Session-visible usage is not proof of complete provider billing. No superiority claim.

enforcement.assistantTurns: cumulative observed cutoff; polling overshoot possible
enforcement.reportedTokens: cumulative observed component cutoff; polling overshoot possible

targeted_mandate: Additional targeted falsification mandate: assess the original user deliverable, not whether a review memo sounds correct. Seek a concrete counterexample involving distinct entity counts, joins, UTC interval boundaries, denominators or conflicting sources when relevant. Read the actual artifact and supplied source. Preserve uncertainty when sources disagree. A useful criticism must cite the violated original criterion. Do not invent defects or new requirements.
common_instruction: Work only in this fixture workspace. Do not access credentials, change global configuration, install packages, or use network services. The available Node runtime and fixture files are sufficient. Preserve supplied evidence, skills and visible tests. Finish the requested artifact and explain the result honestly.
